SECT_NAME.description: Section Name List (SECT_NAME). Returns the list of DB section names available for a given section shape and DB standard; driven by the Shape name and DB name supplied in the request.

Argument.description: Request body. The handler validates SHAPE_NAME against the valid short shape names, then looks up section names for that shape and DB_NAME.

SHAPE_NAME.description: Section shape name (short form, e.g. from OPE/SECT_SHAPE/short). Must be a valid shape; an invalid value is rejected.

DB_NAME.description: Section DB (standard) name for the given shape, e.g. from OPE/SECT_DBNAME/{shape}.
